1.explanation: This simple React app mounts a Carbon MultiSelect with two initial selections. In the rendered HTML, you will see the outer `.bx--list-box__field` rendered as a button (role="button") and, inside it, each Tag filter rendered as its own button (role="button") for the clear icon. Inspecting this in the browser’s devtools reproduces the button-within-button accessibility violation described in the issue.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a Carbon MultiSelect with one or more items already selected (via the `initialSelectedItems` prop), the outer list‐box field is rendered as a <button> (role="button") and each selected item is rendered inside it as a Tag filter, which itself uses a <button> (role="button") for the “×” clear icon. This results in a button nested inside another button, violating the HTML5 spec that a <button> must not contain interactive content descendants.
